title: Our Country
text:
Turkey is a big country. It has many mountains, rivers, and lakes. The capital city is Ankara, and the largest city is Istanbul.

The sea is near many cities. People can see the sea from the coast. In the south, the weather is warm, and in the north, it is often cooler and rainy.

questions.text: What is the capital city mentioned in the first paragraph?
Why might the north be cooler and rainier than the south?
options: It is closer to the sea
The text suggests a different weather pattern there

questions.text: What can we say about Istanbul from the first paragraph?

vocabulary.definition: large streams of water that flow to the sea or a lake
the land along the edge of the sea

paragraph_translations: Türkiye büyük bir ülkedir. Birçok dağı, nehri ve gölü vardır. Başkent Ankara'dır ve en büyük şehir İstanbul'dur.
Deniz birçok şehrin yakınındadır. İnsanlar kıyıdan denizi görebilir. Güneyde hava sıcaktır, kuzeyde ise genellikle daha serin ve yağmurludur.
